headline.caveat: ~40% of Stargate LLC; OpenAI's own capital commitment against the $500B/10GW target not separately disclosed

realized_to_date.caveat: per-partner equity funded undisclosed; program-level >$400B in motion

nature_md: OpenAI holds ~40% of Stargate LLC and runs it operationally (SoftBank ~40% and 'financial responsibility'; Oracle+MGX ~20%). The circular geometry is the point of interest: OpenAI is simultaneously **equity owner** of the vehicle and its **sole anchor customer** — Stargate exists to build capacity that OpenAI then pays to use (Abilene 1.2GW flagship, five sites added Sept 2025, ~7GW→8GW+ planned, Stargate Korea/India/UAE branded extensions). Much of the Oracle $300B contract is delivered from Stargate-developed sites. OpenAI thus sits on both sides of the landlord-tenant line, wearing equity upside on infrastructure whose lease payments are its own future costs.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: JV equity contribution (amount undisclosed) — an investment on OpenAI's balance sheet. Separately, OpenAI's usage contracts with Stargate-delivered capacity (largely via Oracle) create the forward cost obligations recorded on those edges; the LLC structure keeps construction debt off OpenAI's own books.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity capitalization of Stargate LLC, layered with site-level project debt (Abilene: JPMorgan-led $2.3B + $7.1B construction loans via the Crusoe/Blue Owl/Primary Digital JV). The LLC's consolidated financials are not public.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** OpenAI owning its landlord blurs cost discovery — capacity pricing between related parties isn't market-tested, and the SPV lattice hides leverage that ultimately claims OpenAI's future cashflow (Kedrosky: price it like a sovereign-backed utility). **Bull:** vertical integration into infrastructure is what every hyperscaler already did — owning ~40% of the vehicle captures developer margin instead of paying it away, and third-party capital (MGX, project lenders) validates the assets independently.

events.title: Stargate announced: OpenAI takes ~40% and operational lead
